response.sql:
WITH site_counts AS (
  SELECT
    s.zoneregistry,
    COALESCE(SUM(f.traitcount), 0) AS feature_count
  FROM sites AS s
  LEFT JOIN scanfeatures AS f
    ON f.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
   AND f.traitcount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY s.zoneregistry
),
site_shares AS (
  SELECT
    zoneregistry,
    feature_count,
    feature_count::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(feature_count) OVER (), 0) AS share
  FROM site_counts
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    zoneregistry,
    feature_count,
    share,
    AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM site_shares
)
SELECT
  zoneregistry AS site_code,
  feature_count,
  share,
  share - average_share AS margin_above_average
FROM ranked
WHERE share > average_share
ORDER BY margin_above_average DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Sites with no non-NULL detected-feature counts are included with a total of zero; average share is computed across every site, including those zero-count sites.
